steps.text: Unfold absolute continuity into the epsilon-delta budget for disjoint intervals.
Unfold monotonicity: |f(b_k)-f(a_k)| equals f(b_k)-f(a_k), and intervals map into intervals of that length.
Unfold the null set definition: cover E by disjoint open intervals with total length less than delta.
Estimate by bounding outer measure using countable subadditivity: m*(f(E)) is at most the sum of image lengths.
Because epsilon was arbitrary, give yourself epsilon of room and let epsilon go to zero to conclude m(f(E))=0.
